chapters.title: Every spiritual blessing
chapters.summary: Paul praises God who chose us in Christ, adopted us, and redeemed us through His blood. He prays that the believers will know the hope of their calling.

chapters.title: Saved by grace
chapters.summary: We were dead in sin, but God, rich in mercy, made us alive with Christ. By grace you are saved through faith. Christ has broken down the wall between Jew and Gentile.

chapters.title: The mystery revealed
chapters.summary: God's plan is that Gentiles are fellow heirs in Christ. Paul prays that they may know the love of Christ that passes knowledge.

chapters.title: One body
chapters.summary: Walk worthy of your calling, keeping the unity of the Spirit: one body, one Lord, one faith. Speak the truth in love, be kind and forgive one another.

chapters.title: Walk in love
chapters.summary: Be imitators of God and walk in love and light. Be filled with the Spirit. Wives and husbands are to love and honor one another as Christ loves the church.

chapters.title: The armor of God
chapters.summary: Children and parents, servants and masters are given instructions. Be strong in the Lord and put on the whole armor of God, praying always.
